card.text: Giant planet 2.7 au from Beta Pictoris, found by radial velocity and confirmed by interferometry.

sources.label: Nowak et al. 2020
sources.quote: first direct confirmation of a planet discovered through radial velocity

introduction.text: Beta Pictoris c is a giant planet 2.7 au from its star, found by radial velocity and confirmed by GRAVITY. It is nine Jupiter masses on an eccentric 1,221-day orbit.

sources.label: Nowak et al. 2020
sources.quote: first direct confirmation of a planet discovered through radial velocity

sources.label: Lacour et al. 2021
sources.quote: a period of 1221 +/- 15 days, and an eccentricity of 0.32

shape.title: Shape only
shape.summary: A sphere of the model radius, glowing its own heat. No surface, colour or spin is measured.
